div.head: Northu 63
div.ab: Gif hwa wið nunnan forlicge, sy ægðer his weres scildig, ge he ge héo.
Gif hwa wið nunnan forlicge, sy ægðer his weres scildig, ge he ge heo.
Wenn einer mit einer Nonne hurt, sei jeder sein Wergeld schuldig, so er wie sie.
If anyone fornicates with a nun, let each be liable for his wergild, both he and she.
If anyone lies with a nun, both are to be liable to pay their wergild, both he and she.
If anyone fornicates with a nun, they both—he and she—are liable for their wergild.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If anyone lies with a nun, both are liable to pay their wergild, both he and she.’).
